belowFold: Virtualized grid continues below the fold: additional ExerciseTileCard rows (532 total, cached) load as the user scrolls, matching Row 1/2's solid #211008 r24 pattern — image, name, muscle · equipment caption, DifficultyMeter.
imageSlots: HIFI-70-01 — Exercise Library instructional media thumbnails, reused across all ExerciseTileCard grid tiles (Rows 1-2 and the virtualized below-fold continuation); Balencia warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text, no identifiable person.
notes: Fonts: Hanken Grotesk (UI) + Newsreader Medium Italic (emphasis word) stand in for Neue Montreal/Tiempos per session waiver W-FONT-01. Default filters are 'All' (Muscle, single-select) / 'Any' (Equipment, multi-select) — matches the unfiltered 532-exercise count and the mixed muscle-group/equipment grid tiles shown; picking a specific chip re-filters the grid via a 280ms crossfade, and active chips carry a subtle --glow-you orange bleed. Cards scale to .97 on tap with light haptic. DifficultyMeter bars animate their rise on viewport entry; bypassed under prefers-reduced-motion, rendering instantly at final state; Sheet slides up without spring interpolation. Detail sheet (/exercises/[id]) opens as a glass half sheet, top corners r24 (canon reserves r40 for hero/paywall surfaces only), with BtnPrimary 'Add to workout' transitioning to forest-green BtnSuccess 'Added' for 600ms, then disabled at 40% opacity during the mutation to prevent double-taps. Sheet error: opens to skeleton, resolves to a failure message + BtnSecondary 'retry' after 5s. List error: centered offline-cloud glyph, plain-language body text, BtnSecondary 'retry', filters visible but inert. Empty state: centered search glyph, 'No exercises found', no BtnPrimary since filters are the corrective action. Detail sheet's form-safety copy avoids diagnostic or rehab claims unless a licensed source is cited. Screen-reader labels announce exercise name, muscle group, equipment, difficulty, source, and whether media/form cues are available; 44px minimum targets enforced on TopBar actions, filter chips, cards, and the Sheet grabber/CTA zone.
